title: MrBeast Is the First YouTuber Ever to Hit 500 Million Subscribers

scenes.text: One YouTuber just passed 500 million subscribers.
MrBeast became the first creator ever to do it, in June 2026.
He hit 400 million only about a year earlier.
YouTube had to make him a custom play button.
Normal awards stop at 100 million subscribers.
The next biggest channel, T-Series, has about 312 million.
More than 600,000 people watched live as the number rolled over.

description:
One YouTuber just passed 500 million subscribers.
MrBeast became the first creator ever to reach 500 million, in June 2026, about a year after 400 million. YouTube made him a custom play button because the standard awards stop at 100 million.
What's the first MrBeast video you ever watched? Comment below.
first_comment: He needed a custom play button because awards stop at 100 million. What would you name a 500 million award?
